product.title: 6 Hour Private Tour: Acadia National Park, Fjord & Lobster Lunch

description.text: Discover top sights within Acadia National Park with your own personal guide during this private tour. Cover more locations in less time in a comfortable, climate-controlled vehicle. Stops include Cadillac Mountain, Park Loop Road, Asticou Gardens, Southwest Harbor Lobster Pound, Somes Sound. Tours include a stroll through Asticou Gardens, and a tasty lobster lunch stop in Southwest Harbor (meal not included.) Ideal for visitors basing in Bar Harbor who want a guided Acadia National Park experience without coordinating park logistics, trailheads, or carriage roads on their own.
